name: ControlAudioParams
doc: Schema-discoverable audio.control parameters for an existing presentation voice.

fields.name: voice
fields.doc: Session-local runtime voice handle returned by audio.play, never a network entity ID.

fields.name: atFrame
fields.doc: Absolute presentation sample frame at which gain/rate automation begins.

fields.name: parameters
fields.doc: Validated source gain/rate and listener-local acoustic parameters.

fields.name: rampFrames
fields.doc: Linear transition length in output frames; zero requests an explicit hard change.
